title: Bruce Springsteen’s Land of Hope and Dreams American Tour: How to Get Affordable Tickets Online
summary: The rock star goes on the road — tour dates throughout the U.S. starting March 31.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

In spring 2026, Bruce Springsteen & The E Street Band goes on the Land of Hope and Dreams American Tour throughout the United States with 20 dates starting at Target Center in Minneapolis on Tuesday, Mar. 31 and ending at Nationals Park in Washington D.C. on Wednesday, May, 27.

Meanwhile, Rage Against The Machine guitarist Tom Morello is supporting Bruce Springsteen for select songs during the tour. Tickets to the tour first went on sale through Live Nation and Ticketmaster , while the retailer’s Face Value Exchange program is an option for fans to resell tickets.

Shop Bruce Springsteen Tickets at Ticketmaster

However, many of the dates have either sold out, or are very close to selling out, so one of the best ways to find Bruce Springsteen tickets online is through third-party sites, including StubHub , Vivid Seats , SeatGeek and others — all of which guarantee authentic tickets in time for the event.

In addition, Billboard likes that tickets are all delivered digitally, so you can get them sent instantly to your smartphone or email. Prices may also be above or below face value at times.
